### Notes on structure
This demo project represents the complete Stage 3 deliverable. Your folder structure should match mine, and you should have _only one folder_ for your project. 

The folder name needs to be descriptive about the project, not your name.  So, if the folder had been called `nikko-project` I would rename it something like `survey-of-execution-methods`

### Citations
NOTE that the bibliography.bib file is living in my project folder and uses Biblatex formatting to reference citations.  Your projct will do this as well.  The fastest ways to get biblatex information are:

- Using a biblatex browser extension, like [BibItNow for Firefox](https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/bibitnow/)
- Using Google Scholar's Cite popup, and choosing "BibTeX" from the options. 

Wherever you get it from, for each source you cite, you'll add it to _your project's_ bibliography file and then reference it in your project using the [@keyname] syntax. 

For more information about the process of citations, checkout [the quarto reference page](https://quarto.org/docs/authoring/citations.html)
